title: Count Valid Suffix Sorts I
statement: Given nums and target of the same length n (up to 10^5), it counts indices i where sorting the suffix nums[i..n-1] in non-increasing order yields target. The key reduction is that valid i form a window: i must be at least the start of target's longest non-increasing suffix and at most the longest common prefix of nums and target, and the two arrays need equal element frequency counts.
